messages.text: That red/yellow/black canvas you sent has real music-in-motion energy. Did you block the circles before or after rereading that old paperback?
After. The ship chapters had me thinking in spirals, then Tre asked why my knight was trapped on the board like it owed rent.
Send me that red/yellow/black canvas when the light hits it again. The one behind your desk looked better than you thought.
Send me a close-up before you varnish. Also Saturday I am claiming blue pieces if we play after painting.
I had to move two stacks of route sheets just to get to it. That little room is doing too many jobs.
Fine, but if you build across my longest road again I am taking a break to sketch planets.
Still, that piece has a good pull. If somebody asks about a small version, do not underprice it.
I wrote $45 on the back of the 8x10 sticky note and then hid the note under mileage receipts.
Text me when you finish that early route. Miss Lottie asked if you still coming by after service Wednesday.
I will. I paid the power bill last night so I need to keep gas money tight till Friday.
Come eat at my house before you drive back. Marcus said he can listen to that sound if it starts again.
Thank you Mama. Can you pray with me later before I clock in?
Baby, did you see Sister Renee moved the fish fry notice to the group page? It says volunteers need to answer by Friday.
I saw it before my first stop. I tapped going and sent the flyer to Auntie.
Good. Also your cousin put new baby pictures up this morning. That child has your granddaddy's same little frown.
I saved one to show Daddy later. I was already in there checking a used shelf listing near Jasper anyway.
If you going toward Jasper this morning, take Bryan Road past the church. Main stretch got trucks backed up.
That back way is why I keep my sanity. I can pass Mrs. Pruitt's place and be on 78 before folks start honking.
Watch that dip by Old Warrior. You still going to that resume thing after your route?
Yeah, in Jasper at 5:30. Wish it was closer, but I'll swing by Mama's first so I don't sit around town with two hours to kill.
You get that payroll screen printed for your taxes?
Yes sir. February showed $4,100 before all the little lines came out. The part that landed was closer to $3,250.
Keep that copy. Look at the medical and 401k lines too, don't just look at the deposit.
I saved the PDF. Still deciding if I want to book that tooth thing this month after seeing the estimate.
I saved you a spot by the back mirror tonight. No vanishing after that long route.
I know that route had you ready to throw the whole clipboard away, but you still coming at 6:30?
I had a lady call in on me, then the shop texted about the sensor. I just want my shower and silence.
I am changing shoes now. If the warmup song starts before I get there, just wave me in.
Shower first, then sneakers. You can be mad in class. I will drag you through the warmup lol.
Bet. Brianna also asked if Friday is still mic night or if we are moving it because of Malik's ride.
Keep Friday. I can pick Malik up after class and Bri can bring that song list she was laughing about.
Fine. But after class I am going home to look at rent numbers before I answer anybody else.
You still coming to 7:15? I know that route ran you down today but don't leave me in there by myself 😂
You still coming to Zumba or did that route drain you all the way out?
I'm changing now. I put Mahalia on while I heat soup so I can quit replaying the whole day.
Coming. I packed Mama's container first, sent Tre his plate pic, then changed shoes in the car.
Look at you running a whole mini operation before class 😂
Good. Move first, talk mess after. I got your spot by the fan.
After class I may sit with my sketchbook a few minutes before I drive home.
I made a stop order this morning and it actually saved me 22 minutes. Putting that note in my route log tonight.
Don’t try to duck out tonight. I already put your name in for the woman-shouting song 😂
You know I need one warm-up first. Maybe that slow guitar one from the jukebox before y’all hand me the mic.
Fine, one Lucille-type warm-up, then you better spell it out on stage.
If I’m up early enough for the 10:30 seats Sunday, I’m saving my voice a little.
You still cooking that small pan like somebody rationing groceries? I can come help clear it.
It is enough for me plus lunch tomorrow. You always appear when the foil comes off.
You remember that closet by the hall where Dad kept that big metal toolbox? Mama found my old cleats in there.
Mama said Keisha posted another set of porch keys and sold sign pics. Everybody leveling up on the timeline.
That closet had everybody's stuff stacked up. Mine, yours, Daddy's wrenches, and those extra sheets from when Grandma was in the front room.
I saw it. I had to mute it and finish my budget sheet. My next big move needs a steadier check first.
Grandma had the TV loud every afternoon. Mama would come in from checking on folks and still make us hush.
Daddy would be at that shop sink scrubbing grease off before supper while you tried to sneak around him.
That canvas you showed me has the red and yellow fighting in the best way. The dark shapes feel like they are sliding right off the edge.
I kept dragging the brush sideways because stillness felt wrong tonight.
If you pass that white church sign again, get me the version with the power lines lower in the frame.
I might go that way Saturday morning if the clouds stay like they were today.
Try putting one of your silver-braid ladies near the top corner, like she is walking past all that noise.
Maybe with the visor and the gold rings behind her. I want her looking past whatever tried to hold her.
The one near the dollar store and the hay field? That sky was doing too much in a good way.
Yeah. I saved the turn after the gas station so I don't miss it again.
Baby, I saw your post about a hard week. I am praying before I start my first client.
Thank you Mama. I kept it simple on there. I did not want all my business in the comments.
Call me after your early route if your chest still feels tight from all that thinking. We can pray and make a little plan.
I will. I am still getting up and going, just tired from turning the same stuff over in my head.
Baby, Sister Jean asked if you were still bringing that pan for the fellowship hall Saturday.
Yes ma'am. I can do greens and a small skillet of bread if I get off my route on time Friday.
Good. Your aunties already talking about saving seats near the choir side, so come early.
I know how they do. I will bring foil too because somebody always wants a plate for later.
How are your arms feeling today, baby? Drink water and do not lift all those heavy bins at once.
Left one is fine, right one is a little tender. Renee gave me the updated paper and wrote the dates on my card.
Good. I trust a person at that counter more than somebody yelling under a Facebook post.
Same. I saved the county page too so I can check it again if folks start arguing.
Daddy, they said pads plus that sensor came to $420. Does that sound right?
For both, yes. Ask them to show you the old pads and clear the code before you pull off.
I am picking it up after work. I moved the card payment lower till Friday but kept the car draft alone.
Good. Call me when you leave the shop and listen for any grinding.
Road by Dora was washed out again. County meeting flyer says they are taking questions Saturday.
I saw that. I am writing mine down: the bridge, the clinic out past Townley, and why the school roof still leaks.
Put that new insurance card in the visor clip, not loose in the glove box.
That office need your birth place again? Tell them Walker Baptist, same as it shows on the old paper.
Already did. License, insurance, registration all together so I am not digging around.
Yep. They wanted city and county too, so I put Jasper and Walker.
Ask them how they plan to pay for it. Folks promising everything until the bill comes.
That is the part I keep circling. I want a little shop one day, but I do not want workers stuck with bad hours just so a budget looks neat.
Good. And use the Sumiton address history from when you were little, not the Jasper PO box your mama had for a minute.
Good. If blue lights come on, window down, both hands where they can see, talk through each move.
I did. They also asked for the month and day, so I used 4/18 like on my license.
Yes sir. I remembered that after Daryl said that warehouse form had him explaining that old courthouse mess again.
You got a lighter in your glove box? Mine disappeared.
Nope. Check Daddy's toolbox maybe. My car stays plain for route mornings.
Lol you and that spotless car. I forgot you keep it inspection-ready.
I don't give them anything extra to ask about at the terminal.
Board games tomorrow at Malik's. He said his auntie is making that big jar tea again.
I might take one small cup if I do. I am on the early run Sunday, so I am keeping it light.
I figured. I'll save you a plate and keep you away from Tre trying to top everybody off.
Please do. Food, Uno, a little tea, then home.
Baby, I put my sample ballot on the kitchen table. Bring yours Sunday and we can mark the names we still need to look up.
I printed the county one last night. I know the big offices, but those courthouse seats always sneak up on me.
Your grandmama would say read it twice and don't let a shiny mailer make your mind for you.
That's why I'm bringing it. I want to see who answered about the clinic hours and the bus route before I circle anything.
Baby, did you sleep any after standing outside so late?
A little. I keep thinking about the mama who spoke and that paper they passed around with the stop checklist.
Keep it in your glove box and send Tre a copy when he calms down. I prayed over both of you this morning.
I sent him the picture and put the registration link on my page, just no long caption.
Baby did you remember to put something back for your tags before you get to running around today?
I checked the account screen this morning and wrote down what cleared. I can spare $15 after gas.
Good. Put it where you will not touch it, even if it is just that little paper sleeve in your drawer.
Already marked it tags. I am fixing the March rows tonight so I do not guess later.
Baby, did you get that porch light changed before dark?
Yes ma'am. I got the bulb in and set the trash cart back on my side.
Good. Lock both doors and call me after you finish sorting those statements.
I will. I kept the power, water, and rent confirmations together this time.
You taking that extra run this morning? Rain supposed to start after 10.
Yeah, 7 to noon. They texted last night because Tonya called out, so I am packing coffee and keeping it moving.
Check tires before you pull off. And if those folks can get Saturdays posted earlier, listen to them.
That is the part I care about. Earlier notice, dock lights fixed, and everybody getting the same add-on money.
Daddy, that back tire looked a little low after the Jasper run. The handheld kept freezing when I scanned the last two cases too.
Check pressure cold in the morning. Look at your fluid levels before you pull out. If that device acts up, restart it before your first stop.
I will. I still had to key the count in on my phone and leave Mr. Cain a note about Friday.
And get them boots fixed. If the sole is loose, don't climb in and out that truck all day like that.
That old neon sign shot you took off Broadway still has such good color. Did you ever print it?
I put it in the cart but paused it. That little Blue Ridge folder gets first dibs right now.
Fair. If you go through with those overlook screenshots, bring the 50mm and the small tripod.
Already made a gear note. I want mist, old railings, and no rushed schedule this time.
I sent you three carousel posts: one with the red-black shapes, one food plating reel, and that painter in Atlanta with the thick linework.
I saved all three. The Atlanta one is exactly the kind of movement I was trying to get in my sketchbook.
Look at the comments under the warehouse-route clip too. The women in that thread are giving actual useful tire-chain advice.
That is going in my saved folder with the mural ideas and the diner pictures from last weekend.
Mama, do you still have my birth certificate in that lockbox with the church papers?
Yes baby. I can bring it by after service. What do you need it for?
That passport form asks for it. I keep saving Iceland waterfalls and those New Zealand blue lakes like I am really doing something.
Dreams need paperwork too. I will put it in my purse and pray over all of it.
Baby, Sister Elaine said two of the high school seniors still want to sit by you after the fish fry and ask about your routes.
Tell her I can stay after cleanup. I printed that one-page list on permit studying, warehouse jobs, and what shoes not to wear on a dock.
Good. And bring your notebook for that work class too, so you are not rushing after church.
I packed it with the foil pans. I need to review the route-board examples before bed.
That man showing the alley dock with two cones was doing it right. Watch the mirror before you turn in.
I saved it. Same app had a quick dinner with smoked sausage and cabbage right before that.
Just don't stay up chasing clips. You got an early route.
I know. After I send Mama that braid screenshot, it goes on the dresser charger.
That red/yellow/black piece you posted has teeth. Was that from tonight?
Yeah. I could not sleep after staring at the bank app and that shop receipt, so I let the shapes be ugly.
Ugly honest works. Also do not underprice it if somebody asks. You are allowed to make room in the numbers.
I need room. The Visa line is louder than the car line right now, and rent already has a fence around it.
How that rattle on 22 sound today. You make it back?
Pulled in at 4:50. It's worse on the downhill into Cullman, right rear-ish
Brake hardware again most likely. Pull in Saturday before church and I'll look at it
Yeah I'm running 78 north Thursday with another full manifest, don't want it getting worse
You coming to karaoke Friday or you doing that lunchbox discipline again? 😂
Lunchbox is riding shotgun today. I even brought tea so I don't stop at that window by the highway.
Look at you. Friday can be my porch speaker and noodles then, no cover charge.
That sounds better. I got beans and pasta at home anyway.
You still coming at 6:30? I saved our usual left-side spot.
Coming. Been in the car since early, so I need that music to shake me loose.
Good, because I am not doing those fast hip steps alone 😂
Let me change shoes and refill my bottle. Meet you by the side door.
You still got that extra ticket for Regions Field next Friday or you gave it away?
I still got it. You can ride with me if you don't act brand new when I stop for snacks.
Bet. Also mama said y'all had the church mic loud Saturday. I know you did that old song again.
Only one verse. Brianna had me laughing before the board even got set up.
You seen that clip everybody sharing? Dude said the pharmacy stuff been making folks sick for weeks.
Send it if you want, but I am not going by a chopped-up video. I am checking my doctor's portal after lunch.
You always got homework for the internet lol
Because last time the comments had people mixing up two different things. The clinic note was clearer.
That red and black piece you sent has more pull than the last version. Did you work on it after your shift?
Yeah, after dinner. I had B.B. King low and kept repainting the corner until my shoulders finally dropped.
Leave that corner rough. It says more that way. Also drink water before you stare at it another hour.
I'm closing the paint now. Going to write tomorrow's stops down so I don't lie awake sorting them.
Baby when you stop by Sunday, remind your daddy I need that frame fixed. It has my certificate tucked behind your school picture.
The one with your Walker High picture and that little blue card?
Good morning, baby. Did the apartment office need anything else from you yesterday?
Yes ma'am. And please do not let Tre dig in that box, he will start laughing at everybody's hair again.
Just my papers and your number again. I signed after asking about the monthly rate.
That was wise. Do not let seeing other people's announcements rush your steps. Pray, work, and let the right season come.
I'll keep him out of it. Daddy still has his papers in the same drawer with those truck-shop receipts too?
I needed that. I like the idea of more one day, just not while my work hours still jump around.
Baby did you call that office before your route gets busy?
I did. The visit is $45 up front, then the bigger number depends on what they send after. I asked for first opening after 3.
That is wise. Don't let it get worse, but don't let them rush you without telling you the total.
I'm checking my PTO balance too. I don't want to burn a whole afternoon if they only need 20 minutes.
Baby, did you make it in before that rain got bad? Your daddy said the lights flickered by the four-way.
I'm home. Took the road behind New Canaan and barely saw another car. Mr. Earl was still on his porch like always.
Good. I saved you a plate if you want to come by tomorrow after work.
I will if Tre can get me from the print shop Saturday. That bus only gets me as far as Jasper and the timing is messy.
The drip under the sink still doing it?
Little bit. I sent the photo to Mr. Hendrix like you said and put a bowl under it.
If he sends maintenance, move your cleaning stuff first. Don't let them crowd the cabinet.
Already did. I also checked that the water charge cleared before I texted him.
Daddy, is the old road past Empire still bad after that rain?
Stay off the low part by the creek. Gravel washes out there.
I just wanted the bend where the trees open up before the brick houses.
Go in daylight and don't park half in the lane. Those log trucks come fast.
You still coming Tuesday or did that long loop take you out?
I had 16 stops, three signatures missing, and the tablet made me re-enter the Walker feed store note twice.
Girl. Put the clipboard down and come sweat it out 😂
Let me patch this pants knee first. It caught on a pallet edge this morning and looks rough.
Girl I got that candidate card in my mailbox. It has a cute picture and nothing else lol.
Same. I flipped it over looking for anything about paychecks, the Jasper clinic line, or those gravel roads where the school bus turns.
Ask them at church brunch Sunday. You always have the real questions.
I am trying. Then I read the part about cutting paperwork for shops and I think about my future booth, but I still want breaks and overtime clear.
Girl I saw your IG story. Why the little painted squares look like they dancing and arguing at the same time lol
Because I painted them after losing twice. My brain was still counting sheep, brick, and wheat.
Bring that tablet sketch Tuesday. The woman with the stars behind her is the one I meant, not the orange one.
Got you. I am finishing it after a chapter, then I need a rematch where nobody blocks my road.
You still at work?? I was coming by for that spaghetti lol
Just clocked out. Started at 6:30 and got stuck helping with two late pallets.
They need to quit playing with yall schedule.
For real. Some people are meeting after shift Friday to compare hours and write down what keeps changing.
You got anything left from Saturday or did them deacons wipe it out?
Barely. I saved you one container because I knew you would ask.
That's why you my favorite. Daddy said Uncle Ray had everybody stuck at the table telling that bus station story again.
He told it twice and still had Mama laughing. Come by before 9 if you want your plate.
This sheriff post got folks heated. I was about to repost it but idk if it's real.
Send it first. If it ain't from the county site, the paper, or somebody who was in that meeting, leave it sitting.
You always make me do homework lol. Which one you looking at?
The one who showed numbers on jail spending and answered Miss Ellis about Black folks working out in the county, not just downtown.
I sent you that poster draft. The background feels like velvet and stage lights, but maybe too loud?
Keep the deep blue. It makes me think of that bent-note guitar sound without putting a whole guitar on it.
Got you. Also your Saturday-night set list still has the call-and-response song and the spelling song?
Yes, but I need to leave room for the Sunday morning choir run-through, so don’t let Tasha add five more.
If y'all pass that old blue barn again tomorrow, get me a picture before the sun gets high.
We might. Malik changed the route toward Dora because the shoulders are cleaner there.
Good. Also do that long calf stretch when you get back, because last Saturday you were walking like the couch won.
Already packed the band and two waters. I need my legs loose before Monday starts.
Baby, when you fill that church history sheet, put New Canaan in Sumiton for where you grew up serving. You was there from little girl.
I put that, and I added Jasper for the hospital line.
Good. For the family section, mark yours like mine and your daddy's. Leave that first origin question at no like we always do.
Done. They asked age too, so I typed 26 and the 4/18 date.
Baby, did you make it in? That rain had folks sliding all over 78.
I am home. A county car sat behind me awhile, so I kept both hands up top and breathed slow until he turned off.
You did right. Keep your little folder neat and speak before you reach for anything.
I know. Daryl called too, same day that plant told him they had to review extra papers before moving him forward.
I got off at 5. Swing by before dark if that sensor light still blinking.
It blinked twice after my last drop. I can come after I put rent money in the account.
Good. Don't wait on it. Denise saved you a plate and Tre already tried to claim it.
Tell Daddy I'm on the way if he got his tools out. Tre better leave my cornbread alone.
You still riding with Darryl at the yard Monday or did they move that?
Still Monday. He said I can watch how he fixes the missed-stop sheet and calls the next driver without messing up the whole board.
Pay attention to the order he asks questions. Same as checking a truck: do not guess before you look.
I am writing that down. I also want to ask him how he prices a rush pallet when the regular carrier is full.
Karaoke was cute but your Nashville playlist had you acting like you were writing a whole album 😂
That trip still has me thinking every plain notebook is a songbook.
Next board night you better bring the New Orleans jazz photos too. I need proof you had rhythm somewhere.
I can bring those and the new passport photo I took today. It looks like the DMV humbled me twice.
You coming to Aunt Dee's cookout or you acting brand new?
I am coming after I finish laundry. But don't hand me one of them heavy cups.
Lol you always say 'just a splash' like somebody measuring it with a ruler.
Somebody has to measure. I have keys in my hand before daylight Monday.
You good? Saw that little prayer hands post. You never put the real story on Facebook lol
I am okay. Just a lot due at once and my brain would not hush last night.
You need me to pull up or you calling Mama?
Mama already called. I am eating, washing clothes, and getting ready for tomorrow. If it ever starts stopping me from doing regular stuff, I will use that clinic number.
That card you sent me got everybody in my group chat quiet for once.
Good. Read it before you need it, not while you mad on the shoulder somewhere.
You sound like Mama after that church candle night. Did you go to that library thing too?
Yeah, I sat in the back and mostly listened. I did put $15 on the organizer's link after.
Clouds are weird over the old depot this morning. Could be good if we leave before 10.
I packed the camera and the black marker pens. Is Tasha still sleeping through her alarm?
She replied with one eye open. Malik said he can meet near the trailhead after his first loop.
Perfect. I want depot shots, then we can sort pictures before games tonight.
The Jasper coffee place still has three wall slots for April. They need photos by the 20th, nothing fancy.
I can take them by the window if I move the desk lamp and that pile of route maps.
Use the white sheet behind the canvases. Also include the two smaller ones people kept asking about.
I keep waiting until I am worn out after work, then the pictures come out crooked. I will try before my route tomorrow.
Send me the picture with the side swoop and beads when you find it again. The shape would look good with your red earrings.
Found it between a peach cobbler shortcut and this lady falling off beat at choir rehearsal.
That is such a you mix. Screenshot it before your alarm setup steals your attention.
Done. I'm putting it by the closet now so I have to stand up when it rings.
Did that van pull right after the warehouse turn?
A little. I wrote down the mile marker and told dispatch before I took the second load.
Good. Keep your notes exact. What time you stopping by your mama's?
After the 10:30 drop. I promised her I'd fix the porch light before evening service.
Before you pick up Aunt Renee, take that air freshener out the vent. Some inspectors act funny about strong scents in a cab.
Already did. Seats wiped down too, nothing loose in the console.
Good. With your card, keep the cab boring and the paperwork cleaner than clean.
That's how I like it. I need no surprises before Monday routes.
If you coming by, kickoff is 2:30. I put your chair by the small TV.
I'll be there after I grab ice. Don't let Tre touch my chips before halftime.
He already talking noise. Bring that domino box too if y'all staying late.
Got it. If Mama starts that chorus after dinner, I'm hiding behind you.
Sis why you got Aunt Pearl's cornbread card under paint on your table lol
It was a copy, not the real one. The handwriting needed to be in the piece somewhere.
The lady with the helmet and Sunday hat was hard though. Like old family wall picture but in space.
That's what I was trying for. Old table, old song, new sky.
Baby, Aaliyah signed her paperwork for Bevill yesterday. Starts in the fall, Lord willing
Good for her. Tell her don't sleep on the financial aid lady, she helped me when I was over there
I will. Pastor said Janelle finally finished her nursing classes. You ever hear from her?
Not since I packed up that dorm room. Glad she got through it though. Different road for me, you know how it went
Baby, I found two cans of salmon and a bag of rice in my cabinet if you want them after church.
Yes ma'am, that helps. I'm making bowls tonight for the early routes.
Good. Take your thermos too and don't let those little stops eat up your week.
I hear you. I already told Tasha I'm sitting out the movie Thursday.
Girl are you still comparing rooms around Asheville or did bills win again?
Bills got handled. I slid $30 over and closed the tabs before I got tempted by downtown prices.
Look at you being responsible 😂 just make sure one of those places is close to the curvy road with the pretty pull-offs.
That is the whole point. I want early light and space to stop without feeling like Nashville traffic.
Do not let that long route talk you out of tonight.
I was thinking about skipping, but last week I slept better after all that stepping.
Exactly. Come laugh at my wrong turns and then we can grab smoothies.
Fine. I packed leggings this morning so I would have no excuse.
Tag renewal paper came in the mail over here. You got your part started?
Yes sir. I checked my phone app after the route and the little tags sleeve has $45 now.
Keep the receipt when you pay it. And make sure you write that inspection charge down too.
I added a line for it beside gas and brakes so it does not sneak up on me.
Good morning baby. I prayed over your drive. Write your stops down before you leave so you are not carrying all of it at once.
I made the list and packed the little notebook. If I get home tight again I'm putting on the choir record and washing brushes.
That sounds right. Eat something when you get in, then call me after your shower if you need to talk it through.
Baby, I put your sample ballot on the table by the Bible. Check your name before work if you can.
Thank you. I marked the ones I need to look up after my route: school money, clinic hours, wages, and who answered the question about stops getting handled fairly.
Good. And pray over that part about new store fees too. You want your dream, but people still need decent treatment on the clock.
Exactly. I keep asking myself what I would want if I was signing checks and what I would need if I was clocking in.
Baby, when you leave that cookout tomorrow, put your work jacket straight in the wash if folks are hanging around the porch.
I packed a clean hoodie for the ride home. My Monday uniform is staying in the trunk.
That is wise. You worked too hard for that driving card.
Yes ma'am. I keep my stuff separate and don't borrow cups or anything at those parties.
I found that old class patch from Bevill in the garage. It was in the drawer with the Cummins filters.
Save it for Mama's table Sunday. She already has her pin card and Grandma's church photo set aside.
I will. Tre better not throw away those dock-door notes either. I wrote good measurements on them.
He won't. I'll label that whole box before he starts tossing things.
You still coming by after work? Tre left that board set on my table.
Yes sir. I am bringing the book with the desert planet cover and my tablet so I can finish the purple sky layer.
Don't stay up too late moving pieces around. Your route starts early.
I hear you. One match, one sketch pass, then home.
Check them brake pads on your bike before you take off in the morning. County roads got loose gravel after that rain.
I will. Malik said we're cutting across Bryan Road instead of staying by 78.
Keep your hands light on them curves. And don't skip your warm-up just because folks are waiting.
Yes sir. I need that first ten minutes slow anyway or my back stays tight all day.
You still need me Saturday or you found somebody with a car?
Still need you. That workshop in Birmingham starts before anything from here gets useful.
I got you, but you buying gas and them lemon pepper wings on the way back.
Deal. We can cut home through Sipsey and miss the interstate mess. Plus Mama said stop by before dark.
Sis send me that clip with the driver backing into that tiny dock. I lost it when my feed refreshed.
Sent. Check the one after it too, she explains the mirror setup better than the first guy.
Bet. Mama said you found a porch bench cheap around Dora. You still watching that?
Yep, I messaged the seller and saved the post. If they answer, I may ride by after Zumba.
That fence-line shot you sent has the same colors as your red/yellow/black piece, just softer.
That red and black painting you posted felt like you were saying a lot without saying it.
I took three different turns before I found somewhere the cows weren't blocking the gate.
That was the point. I can share colors online easier than a whole paragraph.
Keep the one with the trailer roof barely showing. It feels more like home than the clean one.
Did the clinic give you any names for if the week ever gets too loud?
They gave me a card to keep. I put it in the glove box, but for now I am leaning on y'all and keeping my routine.
That's the one I liked too. The sky was brighter after I crossed the county line.
For Janelle's shower gift, I found a tiny yellow blanket with moons on it. Want me to add your name to the tag?
Yes please. Seeing her registry had me staring at my own cart like, girl, you came for dish soap.
Your cart is allowed to be boring. You are building your own ground first.
True. I want the full picture eventually, but I want my work and money to stop wobbling before I add bigger pieces.
That red-yellow-black piece you posted has a lot of motion in it. Did you finish the corner you hated?
Not yet. I painted over it twice, then left the rough part showing because it fit the week better.
Send me the photo before you price it. Also, did you ever make the little sheet for those ops questions?
Yes, one page: route gaps, driver handoff issues, and what I would change first if they let me test it.
